a: DevFest is the community-run developer conference that Google Developer Groups host around the world each year. DevFest Kochi is GDG Cochin's edition: a full day of talks, hands-on workshops and conversations about building with Google technologies.

q: Do I need to be an experienced developer?
a: No. Sessions range from first steps to deep dives, and students, designers, founders and curious builders are all welcome. Bring a laptop if you want to join a workshop.

Full-day access to every keynote, track and workshop, the community lounge and sponsor booths, DevFest swag, and food and refreshments through the day. The student pass also includes a certificate of participation.

q: Can I speak, sponsor or volunteer?
a: Yes. Write to gdgcochin@gmail.com and tell us what you have in mind.

q: Is there a code of conduct?
a: Yes. DevFest Kochi follows the Google Developer Groups community guidelines. Everyone attending, speaking, sponsoring or volunteering agrees to keep it a harassment-free space.

q: Is anything hidden on this site?
a: Maybe. Four coupons, one checkout each, first come first served. The years line up by date, not by number. The hosts would like a badge of their own. Get lost and you might catch a ferry. And the fishing net at the venue is always hungry.
